stations.challenge: Plan your first day of the holidays. Say three things you do.
followUpQuestions: What do you do on the first day of the holidays?
How do you feel on the last day of school?
Do you get up early or late in summer?
stations.mainQuestion: What do you do when school finishes?
stations.stretch: Your partner plans a day too. Find one thing that is the same in both plans.
stations.subtitle: No school for two months!
stations.title: The First Day of the Holidays

stations.challenge: You have one day and no money. What can you do near your home? Say two ideas.
followUpQuestions: Do you like the sea, the mountains or cities?
Do you like travelling by car, train or plane?
What can you do near your home?
stations.mainQuestion: Where do you want to go in summer?
stations.stretch: Plan a short trip with your partner. Where do you go? Who goes with you?
stations.subtitle: The sea, the mountains or home?
stations.title: Travel or Stay at Home?

stations.challenge: Your friend has no plans this weekend. Invite your friend and say what you can do together.
followUpQuestions: What do you do with your friends?
What do you do with your family?
Do you sometimes want to be alone?
stations.mainQuestion: Who do you spend time with in summer?
stations.stretch: Ask your partner three questions about their summer.
stations.subtitle: Summer with other people
stations.title: Friends and Family

stations.challenge: Choose a summer job: in a café, in a shop or with children. Say why.
followUpQuestions: What jobs can students do in summer?
What job sounds fun?
What do you want to buy this summer?
stations.mainQuestion: Do you want to work in summer?
stations.stretch: You get 100 euros for your work. What do you buy? What do you keep?
stations.subtitle: Work or free time?
stations.title: Summer Jobs and Money

stations.challenge: Say three things you can do in summer without a screen.
followUpQuestions: Do you play games in summer?
How many hours a day do you use your phone?
What can you do without a phone?
stations.mainQuestion: Do you use your phone more in summer?
stations.stretch: Make a plan with your partner: one day with no phones. What do you do?
stations.subtitle: Online or offline?
stations.title: Phones and Games

stations.challenge: It is raining and you are at home. Say three things you can do.
followUpQuestions: Are you sometimes bored in summer?
What do you do when it rains?
Do you like doing nothing?
stations.mainQuestion: What do you do when you are bored?
stations.stretch: Your friend is bored. Give your friend two ideas.
stations.subtitle: Doing nothing is OK.
stations.title: Boring Days and Rest

stations.challenge: Describe a summer photo. Say where you are and who is with you.
followUpQuestions: What do you like to eat in summer?
What is your favourite summer photo?
Who is with you in your favourite summer photo?
stations.mainQuestion: What is your favourite summer memory?
stations.stretch: Your partner describes a summer day. Ask two questions: Where? Who with?
stations.subtitle: Your best summer days
stations.title: Summer Memories

stations.challenge: Say one good thing and one bad thing about going back to school.
followUpQuestions: Are you happy to go back to school?
What do you miss about summer?
What do you want to do next summer?
stations.mainQuestion: Do you like the end of summer?
stations.stretch: Plan next summer with your partner. Say three things you want to do.
stations.subtitle: The end of the holidays
stations.title: Back to School

vocabulary.explanation: time with no school in summer
a short visit to another place
a person you know and like
go from one place to another

warmUp.note: If you want: a short activity to start.
warmUp.prompt: Choose three: beach · friends · family · games · sleep · travel. Tell your partner what you like.

ui.lessonGoal: Ask and answer simple questions about you and your life.
ui.levelTip: Choose 3–4 stations. Listen to an example first. Short answers are OK. You can repeat words and use your hands.

presentation.introduction: Two months without school! Travel, friends, family, rest, money. What do you like about summer? Talk about it with a partner.
presentation.privacyNotice: You can invent examples. You don’t need to talk about your family, money or private plans.
quickStart: Give a reason or an example.
Need more? Open the next task.
presentation.strap: What do you do in summer?
presentation.subtitle: A conversation, not a test
